name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA’s core engine to the latest Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the strongest general-purpose model available today, and its reasoning depth directly boosts EXCAVA’s problem-solving precision—worth more than a 0.5% gain. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the model’s output quality justifies it for core tasks.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t cost—it’s that 3.7 Sonnet’s 0.5% reasoning gain is unproven in EXCAVA’s specific pipeline. Test it against a blind benchmark of your hardest cases; if it doesn’t beat the current model by at least 0.5% on your metrics, the swap is noise. If it does, lock it in—no second-guessing.
